description_en: Starts an RTC cloud recording task
kebab_example: aliyun live start-rtc-cloud-recording --app-id 00000000-7074-0000-9ef5-85c19a400000 --channel-id room1024 --subscribe-params '{"SubscribeUserIdList":[{}]}' --record-params StreamType=0 RecordMode=0 MaxFileDuration=7200 --storage-params '{"OSSParams":{},"StorageType":1,"FileInfo":[{}],"VodParams":{}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartRtcCloudRecording

parameters.help_en: The ID of the app to which the channel to be recorded belongs. The app must belong to the Alibaba Cloud account that calls this operation
parameters.help_zh: 待录制的频道所属app的id。该app需要归属于当前调用接口账号所属的主账号
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel to be recorded. Make sure that the channel has active users when you call this operation. Otherwise, the recording task fails to be created
parameters.help_zh: 待录制的频道对应的id。需要确保调用本接口时，该频道内有用户，否则会创建录制任务失败
parameters.name: channel_id

fields.help_en:
The video input stream type of the UserId. This parameter is valid only when the subscribed stream is not audio-only (StreamType != 1). Valid values:

0: camera. (Default)

1: screen sharing
fields.help_zh:
该UserId的视频输入流类型，仅订阅非纯音频流时（StreamType!=1）有效。取值：

0：摄像头。（默认值）

1：屏幕共享
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The media type of the subscribed UserId. Valid values:

0: original stream, which includes both audio and video. (Default)

1: audio-only stream.

2: video-only stream (valid only in stream mixing recording mode)
fields.help_zh:
订阅的UserId的媒体类型。取值：

0：原始流，即包括音频和视频。（默认值）

1：仅音频流。

2：仅视频流（混流录制模式下有效）
fields.name: stream_type

fields.help_en: The subscribed UserId
fields.help_zh: 订阅的UserId
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en:
The list of subscribed UserId entries. In single-stream recording mode, each UserId is recorded separately. In stream mixing recording mode, the audio and video of all UserIds are mixed into a single set of audio and video.
The array cannot be empty and supports a maximum of 17 elements
fields.help_zh:
订阅的UserId信息列表，单流录制模式下，会对其中每个UserId分别进行录制；混流录制模式下，会将所有UserId的音视频混合到一组音视频中。
数组不能为空，并且最多支持17个元素
fields.name: subscribe_user_id_list

fields.help_en: The maximum duration of a recording file, in seconds. A recording file that exceeds this duration is split. Valid values: 180 to 7200 (up to 2 hours). Default value: 7200
fields.help_zh: 录制文件最大时长（秒）。超过该时长的录制文件会被分割。取值范围须在[180,7200]内，即最大2小时。不指定时，则默认2小时
fields.name: max_file_duration

fields.help_en:
The recording mode. Valid values:

0: single-stream recording mode. A separate recording file is generated for each subscribed UserId.

1: stream mixing recording mode. The streams of all subscribed UserIds are mixed and transcoded, and only one set of recording files is generated
fields.help_zh:
录制模式。取值：

0：单流录制模式，对于订阅的每个UserId，各自生成录制文件。

1：混流录制模式，对于订阅的UserId，将这些用户的流进行混合转码后，仅生成一组录制文件
fields.name: record_mode

fields.help_en:
The media type of the recording output stream. Valid values:

0: original stream, which includes both audio and video. (Default)

1: audio-only stream.

2: video-only stream
fields.help_zh:
录制的输出流的媒体类型。取值：

0：原始流，即包括音频和视频。（默认值）

1：仅音频流。

2：仅视频流
fields.name: stream_type

fields.help_en:
The file naming convention. You can select and combine the following variables in any order:

AppId
ChannelId
UserId (required in single-stream mode. Invalid in stream mixing mode. If selected, the {UserId} string is retained.)
RecordMode
A value of 0 corresponds to Single.
A value of 1 corresponds to Mix.

SourceType
In single-stream mode, this parameter takes effect when the stream type is video-only. SourceType can be set to:
     - 0: corresponds to C (Camera) for camera video stream.
     - 1: corresponds to S (Screen) for screen sharing video stream.
In single-stream mode, when the stream type is audio-only, SourceType is automatically set to A (Audio) to indicate that the recording content is an audio-only stream.
In single-stream mode, when the stream type is original stream, this parameter takes effect. SourceType can be set to:
     - 0: corresponds to OC (Original Camera) for camera original stream.
     - 1: corresponds to OS (Original Screen) for screen sharing original stream.
In other scenarios, the SourceType configuration is invalid. If you manually configure SourceType, the system retains the {SourceType} placeholder string.

StreamType (uses the StreamType parameter under RecordParams)
A value of 0 corresponds to AV (Audio Video) for audio and video streams.
A value of 1 corresponds to A (Audio) for audio stream.
A value of 2 corresponds to V (Video) for video stream.

StartTime: the time when recording starts, in UTC+8 time zone, in a format such as 2025-03-25-11:27:28. (Required when the default value is not used.)

Default values:
Single-stream recording mode
{AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}_{StartTime}
If different StreamType or SourceType values are subscribed for the same UserId, the default value is {AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}{SourceType}{StartTime}.
Stream mixing recording mode
{AppId}{ChannelId}{StartTime}

The string can contain only the variables listed above. Variable names must be enclosed in {}. Variables are separated by a single underscore (_). Each variable can appear at most once in the string.
After the file is named xxx, it is saved in a format such as TaskId/xxx.m3u8, where TaskId is the task ID generated when the cloud recording task is started and is automatically added to the storage path
fields.help_zh:
文件命名格式。可以由以下变量按任意顺序选择并组合：

AppId
ChannelId
UserId（单流模式下必选；混流模式下无效，选择的话会保留为{UserId}字符串）
RecordMode
值为0时对应Single
值为1时对应Mix

SourceType
单流模式下，当流类型为纯视频流时，配置生效，SourceType可配置为：
     - 当值为0时，对应C（Camera）摄像头视频流。
     - 当值为1时，对应S（Screen）屏幕共享视频流。
单流模式下，当流类型为纯音频流时，SourceType自动配置为A（Audio），用于标识该录制内容为纯音频流。
单流模式下，当流类型为原始流时，配置生效，SourceType可配置为：
     - 当值为0时，对应OC（Original Camera）摄像头原始流。
     - 当值为1时，对应OS（Original Screen）屏幕共享原始流。
其他场景下，SourceType配置无效，若用户手动配置了SourceType，系统将会保留{SourceType}占位符字符串。

StreamType（使用RecordParams参数下的StreamType参数）
当值为0时对应AV（Audio Video）音频流与视频流。
当值为1时对应A（Audio）音频流。
当值为2时对应V（Video）视频流。

StartTime：开始录制的时间，为东八区时区，格式类似2025-03-25-11:27:28。（不使用默认值时必选）

默认值如下：
单流录制模式
{AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}_{StartTime}
如果同时订阅了同一个UserId的不同StreamType或不同SourceType，则默认值为{AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}{SourceType}{StartTime}
混流录制模式
{AppId}{ChannelId}{StartTime}

字符串只能由以上变量组成，变量名需要用{}包裹，变量名之间用一个下划线（_）分隔，每个变量至多在字符串内出现一次。
当命名为xxx后，文件最终会保存为类似TaskId/xxx.m3u8的形式，其中TaskId是在启动云端录制任务时生成的任务id，会自动添加到存储路径中
fields.name: file_name_pattern

fields.help_en:
The file storage path. Each element in the array corresponds to a directory level. For example, if the parameter value is ["dir1","dir2"], the xxx.m3u8 file is saved as dir1/dir2/TaskId/xxx.m3u8. If this parameter is empty, the file is saved directly as TaskId/xxx.m3u8.
The TaskId of the task is automatically appended to the end of the path to prevent recording files from different tasks from being mixed together.
If FilePathPrefix is specified, each element in the array can contain only letters (a-zA-Z), digits (0-9), hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and cannot be an empty string.
The total length of all directory levels concatenated together cannot exceed 128 characters (including the connecting "/" characters, but excluding the automatically appended TaskId). For example, if the parameter value is ["dir1","dir2"], the concatenated path is "dir1/dir2/", meaning the total number of characters in all elements plus the array length (corresponding to the "/" after each level) cannot exceed 128.
The array can contain a maximum of 5 elements, meaning you can customize up to 5 directory levels
fields.help_zh:
文件存储路径。数组中的元素对应每一级目录，例如参数值为["dir1","dir2"]时，xxx.m3u8文件将被保存为dir1/dir2/TaskId/xxx.m3u8。该参数为空时，上述例子将直接保存为TaskId/xxx.m3u8。
路径结尾会自动补充任务的TaskId，以避免不同任务的录制文件混在一起。
如果设置了FilePathPrefix，那么数组中每个元素，只能由英文字母（a-zA-Z）、数字（0-9）、短横线（-）、下划线（_）组成，并且不能为空字符串。
数组中各层路径拼接好后，总长度不能超过128个字符（包括连接的'/'，不包括自动填入的TaskId）。例如参数值为["dir1","dir2"]，那么拼接好的路径就是"dir1/dir2/"，也即数组中所有元素的总字符数与数组长度之和（对应每层路径后的"/"），不得超过128。
数组中元素个数不得超过5，即最多自定义5层路径
fields.name: file_path_prefix

fields.help_en:
The file storage format. Valid values:

HLS
MP4
MP3
fields.help_zh:
文件存储格式。取值：

HLS
MP4
MP3
fields.name: format

fields.help_en:
The segment length, in seconds. This parameter is valid only in HLS format. Valid values: 10 to 30. Default value: 30.

If you do not have special requirements, use the default value
fields.help_zh:
指定切片时长，单位为秒，仅HLS格式下有效，取值范围须在[10,30]内。（默认值为30）

没有特殊需求时，建议直接使用默认值
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en:
The segment naming convention. This parameter is valid only in HLS format. Similar to FileNamePattern, but with an additional variable Sequence:

AppId
ChannelId
UserId (required in single-stream mode. Invalid in stream mixing mode. If selected, the {UserId} string is retained.)
RecordMode
A value of 0 corresponds to Single.
A value of 1 corresponds to Mix.

SourceType
In single-stream mode, this parameter takes effect when the stream type is video-only. SourceType can be set to:
     - 0: corresponds to C (Camera) for camera video stream.
     - 1: corresponds to S (Screen) for screen sharing stream.
In single-stream mode, when the stream type is audio-only, SourceType is automatically set to A (Audio) to indicate that the recording content is an audio-only stream.
In single-stream mode, when the stream type is original stream, this parameter takes effect. SourceType can be set to:
     - 0: corresponds to OC (Original Camera) for camera original stream.
     - 1: corresponds to OS (Original Screen) for screen sharing original stream.
In other scenarios, the SourceType configuration is invalid. If you manually configure this parameter, the system retains the {SourceType} placeholder string.

StreamType (uses the StreamType parameter under RecordParams)
A value of 0 corresponds to AV (Audio Video) for audio and video streams.
A value of 1 corresponds to A (Audio) for audio stream.
A value of 2 corresponds to V (Video) for video stream.
StartTime: the time when recording starts, in UTC+8 time zone, in a format such as 2025-03-25-11:27:28. (Required when the default value is not used.)

Sequence: in HLS format, the ts file name contains Sequence. This variable is invalid for other formats. (Required when the default value is not used.)

Default values:
Single-stream recording mode
{AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}{StartTime}{Sequence}
If different StreamType or SourceType values are subscribed for the same UserId, the default value is {AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}{SourceType}{StartTime}_{Sequence}.
Stream mixing recording mode
{AppId}{ChannelId}{StartTime}_{Sequence}

The string can contain only the variables listed above. Variable names must be enclosed in {}. Variables are separated by a single underscore (_). Each variable can appear at most once in the string.
After the segment is named xxx, it is saved in a format such as TaskId/xxx.ts, where TaskId is the task ID generated when the cloud recording task is started and is automatically added to the storage path
fields.help_zh:
切片命名格式，仅在HLS格式下有效。与FileNamePattern类似，只是可选变量多出了Sequence：

AppId
ChannelId
UserId（单流模式下必选；混流模式下无效，选择的话会保留为{UserId}字符串）
RecordMode
值为0时对应Single
值为1时对应Mix

SourceType
单流模式下，当流类型为纯视频流时此参数生效，SourceType可配置为：
     - 取值为0，对应C（Camera）摄像头视频流。
     - 取值为1，对应S（Screen）屏幕共享流。
单流模式下，当流类型为纯音频流时，SourceType自动配置为A（Audio），用于标识该录制内容为纯音频流。
单流模式下，当流类型为原始流时，配置生效，SourceType可配置为：
     - 当值为0时，对应OC（Original Camera）摄像头原始流。
     - 当值为1时，对应OS（Original Screen）屏幕共享原始流。
其他场景下，SourceType配置无效，若用户手动配置该参数，系统将保留`{SourceType}`占位符字符串。

StreamType（使用RecordParams参数下的StreamType参数）
当值为0时对应AV（Audio Video）包含音频流与视频流。
当值为1时对应A（Audio ）音频流。
当值为2时对应V（Video）视频流。
StartTime：开始录制的时间，为东八区时区，格式类似2025-03-25-11:27:28。（不使用默认值时必选）。

Sequence：HLS格式下，ts文件名中包含Sequence，其他格式下无效。（不使用默认值时必选）。

默认值如下：
单流录制模式
{AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}{StartTime}{Sequence}
如果同时订阅了同一个UserId的不同StreamType或不同SourceType，则默认值为{AppId}{ChannelId}{UserId}{SourceType}{StartTime}_{Sequence}
混流录制模式
{AppId}{ChannelId}{StartTime}_{Sequence}

字符串只能由以上变量组成，变量名需要用{}包裹，变量名之间用一个下划线（_）分隔，每个变量至多在字符串内出现一次。
当命名为xxx后，切片文件最终会保存为类似TaskId/xxx.ts的形式，其中TaskId是在启动云端录制任务时生成的任务id，会自动添加到存储路径中
fields.name: slice_name_pattern

fields.help_en:
The file storage information, which specifies the format, storage location, and naming convention of recording files. This parameter is valid only when StorageType is set to OSS.

A recording file is generated for each element in the array based on the corresponding configuration. If no format is specified, the HLS format is used by default
fields.help_zh:
文件存储信息，用于指定录制文件的格式、存储位置和命名，仅在StorageType为OSS时有效。

对于数组中每个元素，会分别生成对应配置的录制文件。不设置任何格式时，会默认包含HLS格式的配置
fields.name: file_info

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket. The bucket must belong to the Alibaba Cloud account that calls this operation
fields.help_zh: OSS存储的Bucket名称。该Bucket需要归属于当前调用接口账号所属的主账号
fields.name: oss_bucket

fields.help_en: The endpoint of the OSS storage. The corresponding region ID must be the same as the selected service registration endpoint
fields.help_zh: OSS存储的Endpoint名称。所对应的regionId需要与选择的服务接入点一致
fields.name: oss_endpoint

fields.help_en: The OSS storage configuration. This parameter is required when the storage method is OSS and is invalid when the storage method is VOD
fields.help_zh: OSS存储配置。当存储方式为OSS时必须配置，当存储方式为VOD时无效
fields.name: oss_params

fields.help_en:
The storage method. Valid values:

0: VOD
1: OSS
fields.help_zh:
存储方式。取值：

0：VOD
1：OSS
fields.name: storage_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic merging. Valid values:
0: Disabled. (Default)
1: Enabled. If enabled, the ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId parameter must be specified
fields.help_zh:
自动合并。取值：
0：关闭自动合并。（默认值）
1：开启自动合并。开启时必须设置参数ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId
fields.name: auto_compose

fields.help_en:
The ID of the video-on-demand transcoding template group used to transcode the automatically composed new video in the video-on-demand service. This is the resource file used for the transcoding operation.

This parameter is required only when AutoCompose is set to 1.
If only one media asset resource file exists when recording ends, automatic merging is not triggered even if it is enabled.
For common issues about automatic composition and transcoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99726.html.
For billing details of video-on-demand transcoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188308.html
fields.help_zh:
对自动合成出来的新视频在点播服务中进行一次转码，所使用的点播转码模板组ID。

当AutoCompose（是否开启自动合并）设为1时，本参数才必填。
如果结束录制时，只有一个媒体资源文件，那么即便开启自动合并，也不会触发。
自动合成和转码常见问题，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99726.html。
点播转码计费详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188308.html
fields.name: compose_vod_transcode_group_id

fields.help_en:
The storage address listed in the video-on-demand console under Media Asset Management Configuration > Storage Management. Recording files are first saved to this location and then uploaded to VOD.


This parameter is required when StorageType is set to 0 (VOD pattern).
Make sure that the area of this storage address is the same as the selected service registration endpoint
fields.help_zh:
点播控制台->媒资管理配置->存储管理中包含的存储地址，录制文件会先保存到这里，再上传到VOD。


当 StorageType=0（VOD模式）时本参数必填。
请确保该存储地址所在区域与选择的服务接入点一致
fields.name: storage_location

fields.help_en:
The ID of the video-on-demand transcoding template group.


This parameter is required when StorageType is set to 0 (VOD pattern).
Make sure that the area of this transcoding template group ID is the same as the selected service registration endpoint
fields.help_zh:
点播转码模板组ID。


当 StorageType=0（VOD 模式）时本参数必填。
请确保该转码模板组ID所在区域与选择的服务接入点一致
fields.name: vod_transcode_group_id

fields.help_en:
The video-on-demand (VOD) storage configuration. This parameter is required when the storage method is VOD and is invalid when the storage method is OSS.



The US (Virginia) region does not support recording to VOD
fields.help_zh:
VOD存储配置。当存储方式为VOD时必须配置，当存储方式为OSS时无效。



美国（弗吉尼亚）区域暂不支持录制到VOD
fields.name: vod_params

fields.help_en: The audio bitrate in kbps. Valid values: 8 to 500. This parameter is required in stream mixing mode
fields.help_zh: 音频码率（kbps），取值范围须在[8, 500]内。混流模式下必填
fields.name: audio_bitrate

fields.help_en:
The number of audio channels. Valid values:
1: mono.
2: stereo.

This parameter is required in stream mixing mode
fields.help_zh:
音频声道数。取值：
1：单通道。
2：双通道。

混流模式下必填
fields.name: audio_channels

fields.help_en:
The audio sample rate in Hz. Valid values:
8000
16000
32000
44100
48000

This parameter is required in stream mixing mode
fields.name: audio_sample_rate

fields.help_en:
The frame fill type for stream interruption. Valid values:
0: Fill with the last frame. (Default)
fields.help_zh:
断流补帧类型。取值：
0：补最后一帧。（默认值）
fields.name: frame_fill_type

fields.help_en:
The video bitrate in kbps. Valid values: 1 to 10000.
This parameter is required in stream mixing mode when the recording output is expected to contain video. It is invalid in other cases
fields.help_zh:
视频码率（kbps），取值范围须在[1,10000]内。
混流模式下，期望录制输出包含画面时必填，其他情况下无效
fields.name: video_bitrate

fields.help_en:
The video encoding format. Valid values:
H.264 (Default)
H.265
fields.help_zh:
视频编码格式。取值：
H.264（默认值）
H.265
fields.name: video_codec

fields.help_en:
The video frame rate in fps. Valid values: 1 to 60.
This parameter is required in stream mixing mode when the recording output is expected to contain video. It is invalid in other cases
fields.help_zh:
视频帧率（fps），取值范围须在[1,60]内。
混流模式下，期望录制输出包含画面时必填，其他情况下无效
fields.name: video_framerate

fields.help_en:
The video GOP. An I-frame exists every VideoGop frames. Valid values: 1 to 60.
This parameter is required in stream mixing mode when the recording output is expected to contain video. It is invalid in other cases
fields.help_zh:
视频GOP，每VideoGop帧存在一个I帧，取值范围须在[1,60]内。
混流模式下，期望录制输出包含画面时必填，其他情况下无效
fields.name: video_gop

fields.help_en: The video height in pixels. Valid values: 0 to 1920. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 视频高度（px），取值范围须在[0,1920]内。（默认值为0）
fields.name: video_height

fields.help_en: The video width in pixels. Valid values: 0 to 1920. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 视频宽度（px），取值范围须在[0,1920]内。（默认值为0）
fields.name: video_width

parameters.help_en: The transcoding parameters. Leave this parameter empty in single-stream recording mode. This parameter is required in stream mixing recording mode
parameters.help_zh: 转码相关参数，单流录制模式下不填，混流录制模式下必填
parameters.name: mix_transcode_params

fields.help_en:
The display mode for the output. Valid values:
0: Crop. (Default)
1: Scale and display with black borders
fields.help_zh:
画面输出时的显示模式。取值：
0：裁剪。（默认值）
1：缩放并显示黑底
fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The URL of the background image. Maximum length: 2048 characters
fields.help_zh: 背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The global background image for stream mixing
fields.help_zh: 混流全局背景图
fields.name: mix_background

fields.help_en: The pane height as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 窗格高度，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The video input stream type of the UserId. This parameter is invalid if UserId is not specified. Valid values:
0: camera. (Default)
1: screen sharing.

The combination of UserId and SourceType specified here must be included in SubscribeUserIdList
fields.help_zh:
该UserId的视频输入流类型。不填写UserId时，此处设置SourceType无效。取值：
0：摄像头。（默认值）
1：屏幕共享。

这里设置的UserId与SourceType的组合必须包含在SubscribeUserIdList中
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The display mode for the sub-pane output. Valid values:
0: Crop. (Default)
1: Scale and display with black borders
fields.help_zh:
子画面输出时的显示模式。取值：
0：裁剪。（默认值）
1：缩放并显示黑底
fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The URL of the background image. Maximum length: 2048 characters
fields.help_zh: 背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The background image of the sub-pane. When a user turns off the camera, has not started stream ingest after joining the channel, or leaves the channel midway, the corresponding image is displayed at the layout position
fields.help_zh: 子画面背景图，当用户关闭摄像头、或入会后未推流、或入会后中途离会时，会在布局位置填充为对应的图片
fields.name: sub_background

fields.help_en:
The UserId corresponding to this window.
If UserId is not specified, the windows are filled in the order in which the subscribed users join the channel.
The combination of UserId and SourceType specified here must be included in SubscribeUserIdList.
Audio-only streams cannot be added to the layout
fields.help_zh:
该窗口对应的UserId。
不设置UserId时，会按照订阅的用户进入频道的顺序依次填入窗口。
这里设置的UserId与SourceType的组合必须包含在SubscribeUserIdList中。
订阅纯音频流是不能加入到布局中的
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The pane width as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 窗格宽度，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The X coordinate as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 坐标X，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: The Y coordinate as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 坐标Y，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The Z-order of the pane. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推。(默认为0)
fields.name: z_order

fields.help_en: The window layout information of the subscribed users. Only users whose UserId has layout information configured are placed in the video. This parameter is required when the stream mixing mode is used and the recording is not audio-only
fields.help_zh: 用于指定订阅的用户的窗口布局信息，只有设置了布局信息的UserId，才会被放到画面中。混流模式且录制非纯音频文件时必填
fields.name: user_panes

parameters.help_en: The layout parameters. Leave this parameter empty in single-stream recording mode. This parameter is required in stream mixing recording mode when the recording output is expected to contain non-audio-only files
parameters.help_zh: 布局相关参数，单流录制模式下不填，混流录制模式下期望录制出非纯音频文件时必填
parameters.name: mix_layout_params

parameters.help_en:
The URL for receiving callback messages. Task status messages are sent to this URL in JSON format by using the POST method. The maximum length is 2048 characters.

For more information about callback messages, see Documentation (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/live/on-cloud-recording-callback-message)
parameters.help_zh:
接受回调消息地址。任务状态消息会通过POST方式，以Json格式推送到该地址，最大长度不超过2048个字符。

回调消息说明参考文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/live/on-cloud-recording-callback-message)
parameters.name: notify_url

parameters.help_en:
The authentication key for callback messages. If this parameter is left empty (default), no authentication is performed. If specified, the value must be 16 to 64 characters in length and can contain only uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.
If NotifyUrl is not specified, NotifyAuthKey is also invalid.
If a valid NotifyAuthKey is specified, authentication content is included in the callback messages
parameters.help_zh:
回调消息鉴权key，默认不填，即不做鉴权。如果填写，长度需要在[16,64]个字符内，且只由大小写英文字母和数字组成。
当NotifyUrl未填写时，NotifyAuthKey也无效。
当设置有效的NotifyAuthKey时，会在回调消息内携带鉴权内容
parameters.name: notify_auth_key

parameters.help_en: The specified formats for which a callback message is sent when the recording file generation event (RecordFileUploaded) is triggered
parameters.help_zh: 指定的格式，在触发录制文件生成事件（RecordFileUploaded）时，将发送回调消息
parameters.name: notify_file_uploaded_format

parameters.help_en:
The idle timeout period. When the task remains idle for longer than MaxIdleTime, the task is automatically stopped. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 10 to 14400 (maximum 4 hours). Default value: 300.
In stream mixing recording mode, the task is considered idle when all subscribed user streams stop stream ingest.
In individual stream recording mode, the subscribed streams are independent of each other. When any stream stops stream ingest, it is considered idle. After MaxIdleTime is reached, the recording of that stream is stopped. When all subscribed streams have been idle beyond the timeout, the entire cloud recording task is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
空闲超时时间，当任务处于空闲状态的时长超过MaxIdleTime时，自动停止任务。单位为秒，范围须在[10,14400]内，即最大4小时。（默认为300秒）
对于混流录制模式，当所有订阅的用户流都停止推流时算作空闲
对于单流录制模式，订阅的流之间彼此独立，任意一路流停止推流都算作空闲，达到MaxIdleTime后会停止该路流的录制，当所有订阅流都空闲超时后，会停止整个云端录制任务
parameters.name: max_idle_time
